portugal_policy.title: 🇵🇹 Portugal Policy & Law
portugal_policy.content:
• **Repeal of the Extraordinary Contribution on Local Accommodation (CEAL):** The government signed the measure to abolish the CEAL tax for short-term rentals. Previously: Owners were required to pay an extraordinary tax based on a formula involving the property's area and turnover. Now: This tax is completely eliminated. This directly increases the net annual profitability for short-term rental investors. [Portugal.gov.pt]

• **Administrative Simplex for Business Licensing:** A new decree-law replaces the requirement for "prior authorization" with "prior communication" for a wide range of low-risk commercial activities. Previously: Entrepreneurs had to obtain a municipal license and wait for approval before opening their business. Now: Businesses can open immediately upon submitting a notification to the local authority. This reduces the administrative startup lead time from an average of 180 days to 0 days. [Diário da República]

• **Reform of the Foreigners' Residence Permit Process:** The government has abolished the "manifestation of interest" (manifestação de interesse) mechanism for work permits. Previously: Foreigners could enter Portugal as tourists and subsequently apply for residency after securing employment. Now: Work visas must be applied for and granted at a Portuguese consulate in the home country prior to entry. This eliminates the legal ambiguity and multi-year waiting periods for foreign professionals entering the Portuguese market. [Portugal.gov.pt]

Why it matters: The shift toward deregulation in housing and business licensing, coupled with stricter immigration controls, significantly lowers operational costs for investors while formalizing the labor market.

ai_tools_snapshot.title: AI Tools Snapshot
ai_tools_snapshot.content:
AI TOOLS SNAPSHOT
Category | Pedro uses | Best today | Alternative | Cost/Plan | Migration effort | Switch? | Reason
Coding / Agents | Claude Code + GPT Codex | Claude Code | GitHub Copilot Workspace | $10/mo | Low | Optimal | Claude Code's agentic integration is currently peak for sophisticated devs.
Excel / Spreadsheets | Claude.ai | MS Copilot | Google Sheets AI | Free/Sub | Low | Consider | Copilot handles direct cell manipulation better than a chat interface.
Presentations | Claude.ai | Gamma | Tome | Free tier | Medium | Upgrade | Gamma generates full visual layouts and slides rather than just text outlines.
Documents / Word | Claude.ai | Claude.ai | MS Copilot | Free/Sub | Low | Optimal | Claude's reasoning and prose remain superior for high-end document drafting.
LaTeX / Overleaf | Overleaf + Claude.ai | Overleaf + Claude | Typst | Free | High | Optimal | This combination remains the gold standard for technical academic publishing.
Knowledge Management | Claude.ai | Notion AI | Obsidian + Smart Connections | Free/Sub | Medium | Consider | Notion and Obsidian provide structured long-term persistence that Claude Projects lack.
Image Generation | GPT-4o / Google Nano Banana 2 | Midjourney v7 | Flux.1 | $10-30/mo | Low | Consider | Midjourney and Flux.1 offer significantly higher aesthetic fidelity and prompt adherence.
Research / Web Search | Perplexity | Perplexity | SearchGPT | Free/Sub | Low | Optimal | Perplexity's citation engine is still the most reliable for rigorous research.
Transcription / Audio | None | Whisper (Local) | Otter.ai | Free (Local) | Low | Upgrade | Local Whisper (via MacWhisper) provides free, private, pro-grade transcription.
Task Automation | Claude.ai | Zapier Central | Make.com | Free tier | Medium | Consider | Dedicated automation tools handle API triggers and workflows better than chat.

Takeaway: Implement local Whisper for transcription and Gamma for presentations to fill the two largest functional gaps in your current AI stack.
